title: Complete Tears of the Kingdom Cooking Guide: Best Recipes and Special-Effect Dishes | Tears of the Kingdom Guide
pairs: 王国之泪料理合成完整攻略，涵盖回血、加攻、耐寒、耐热等全效果料理配方，星级食材获取方式，最高效实用食谱推荐，让你轻松掌握料理系统精髓。

A complete Tears of the Kingdom cooking guide covering recipes for every effect — heart recovery, attack up, cold resistance, heat resistance, and more — plus how to obtain high-quality ingredients and the most efficient, practical recipe recommendations, so you can easily master the cooking system.
王国之泪料理合成全收录，含回血、强化、耐寒耐热效果的最优食谱推荐。
Every Tears of the Kingdom cooking recipe collected, with the best recipe recommendations for heart recovery, buffs, and cold and heat resistance.
全 228 种料理完整收录 · 游戏原图 · 烹饪配方一览
All 228 dishes fully collected · In-game artwork · Full cooking recipe list
烹饪基础：在篝火旁按 A 键打开锅，放入 1~5 种食材即可烹饪。同类效果食材叠加效果更强，混合不同效果的食材会互相抵消。满月之夜有概率触发「暴击烹饪」，效果翻倍。点击卡片可查看详情。

Cooking Basics: By a campfire, press A to open the cooking pot, then add 1–5 ingredients to cook. Ingredients with the same effect stack to a stronger effect, while mixing ingredients with different effects cancels them out. On a full-moon night, cooking has a chance to trigger a “critical cook,” doubling the effect. Click a card to see details.

ZeldaCentral 配方表给出的固定加成。
Fixed bonus from the ZeldaCentral recipe table.
药水加成由昆虫／青蛙／蜥蜴决定，怪物素材只影响持续时间，不改变加成种类；怪物素材越高级，持续时间越长。
For elixirs, the bonus is determined by the insect, frog, or lizard; monster parts only affect duration, not the bonus type; higher-grade monster parts give a longer duration.
所有冷冻食品固定带耐热加成，代价是回血略低于生食材。
All frozen foods always carry Heat Resistance, at the cost of restoring slightly fewer hearts than the raw ingredient.
烤食不保留食材的加成效果，只恢复生命（烤后回血约为生食材的 1.5 倍）。
Roasted food does not keep the ingredient’s bonus effect; it only restores hearts (roasting restores about 1.5× the hearts of the raw ingredient).
温泉水煮蛋仅恢复生命，无额外加成。
A hot-spring-boiled egg only restores hearts, with no extra bonus.
用非食材或不兼容材料煮出，回血极少，无加成。
Cooked from non-ingredients or incompatible materials; restores very few hearts and gives no bonus.
只用矿石煮出，又硬又难吃，回血极少，无加成。
Cooked using only ore; hard and unappetizing, restores very few hearts and gives no bonus.
单独用妖精煮出，喝下恢复全部生命。
Cooked from a fairy alone; drinking it restores all hearts.
暗黑团块提供瘴气抗性，每份提供 1 点抗性点数，放得越多抗性越强。
Dark Clumps grant Gloom Resistance, 1 resistance point per clump; more clumps mean stronger resistance.
注意：暗黑团块单独煮会失败，必须按配方搭配其他食材。
Note: cooking Dark Clumps alone will fail — they must be combined with other ingredients as in the recipe.
怪物精华会随机化结果：持续时间固定为 1 分钟、10 分钟或 30 分钟三档之一；回血或加成强度随机增强或减弱；且无法获得暴击加成。

Monster Extract randomizes the result: duration is fixed at one of three tiers — 1 minute, 10 minutes, or 30 minutes; heart recovery or bonus strength is randomly increased or decreased; and no critical-cooking bonus is possible.
本配方本身无固定加成，随机结果主要影响回血量。
This recipe itself has no fixed bonus; the random result mainly affects heart recovery.
同效果食材叠加可提升加成等级和持续时间；不同效果食材混用会互相抵消。
Stacking ingredients with the same effect raises the bonus level and duration; mixing ingredients with different effects cancels them out.
这道菜的配方里有任选材料，加成随你的选择而变
This dish’s recipe includes an ingredient you may choose freely, and the bonus changes with your choice
选定一种后，不要再混入其他效果食材。
Once you have chosen one, do not mix in ingredients with other effects.
配方里同时有等不同效果食材，按游戏规则一锅只能有一种加成，不同效果混用会互相抵消或只保留最强的一种，做出来大概率只有回血，没有稳定加成。

The recipe contains ingredients with different effects; by the game’s rules a pot can only have one bonus, so mixed effects cancel each other out or only the strongest one remains, and the result will most likely restore hearts only, with no stable bonus.
想稳定出加成，请只放同一种效果的食材。
To get a stable bonus, use only ingredients with the same effect.
选普通食材则仅回血；同效果食材叠加可提升等级和持续时间。
Choosing an ordinary ingredient restores hearts only; stacking same-effect ingredients raises the level and duration.
这道菜的配方里没有带加成的食材，吃下只恢复生命；回血量随食材品质和数量提升，满月夜烹饪有概率暴击翻倍。

This dish’s recipe contains no bonus-granting ingredients; eating it only restores hearts. Heart recovery rises with ingredient quality and quantity, and cooking on a full-moon night has a chance to critically double the result.
加成优先采用 ZeldaCentral 配方表的固定加成；配方表未给固定加成的锅煮料理，加成由食材决定（同一道菜换不同食材，加成会跟着变）。

Bonuses use the ZeldaCentral recipe table’s fixed bonuses first; for pot dishes the table gives no fixed bonus for, the bonus is determined by the ingredients (changing ingredients in the same dish changes the bonus).
回血量：锅煮料理取决于食材，烤食／冷冻／温泉为固定值。
Heart recovery: pot dishes depend on ingredients, while roasted, frozen, and hot-spring dishes have fixed values.
取决于食材：回血量 = 各食材回血之和 ×2；满月夜暴击可再翻倍。
Depends on ingredients: heart recovery = the sum of each ingredient’s heart recovery × 2; a full-moon-night critical cook can double it again.
篝火烤食：一次只用 1 个食材，直接扔进火里即可。
Campfire roasting: use only 1 ingredient at a time; just toss it directly into the fire.
极寒冷冻：一次冻 1 个食材，放在冰雪上即可。
Extreme-cold freezing: freeze 1 ingredient at a time; just place it on ice or snow.
温泉：放 1 个鸟蛋进温泉即可。
Hot spring: just place 1 bird egg in the hot spring.
药水：昆虫／青蛙／蜥蜴至少 1 只 + 怪物素材至少 1 个，锅最多放 5 个；怪物素材越多、越高级，持续时间越长。
Elixirs: at least 1 insect, frog, or lizard + at least 1 monster part, with at most 5 items in the pot; more and higher-grade monster parts mean a longer duration.
失败料理：按上面材料煮出即为失败品。
Failed dish: cooking with the ingredients above produces a failed dish.
锅最多放 5 个材料；上面是 ZeldaCentral 配方表的原配方，重复出现的材料已合并为数量（如肉×4 表示 4 份）。
A pot holds at most 5 ingredients; the above is the ZeldaCentral recipe table’s original recipe, with repeated ingredients merged into quantities (e.g. meat ×4 means 4 portions).
剩余空位可补同类或同效果食材（不要补不同效果食材）。
Remaining slots may be filled with the same kind or same-effect ingredients (do not add different-effect ingredients).
一档肉 = 兽肉／禽腿肉类，二档肉 = 高级兽肉／高级禽腿肉类，三档肉 = 顶级兽肉／整只禽肉类。
